target: 567 Possibilis Effusor

source: 567 Possible Leaker
target: 567 Possibilis Effusor

source: The failure of the sea prayer ritual last year caused an anomaly in the sea? Lumian couldn’t help but interpret it that way after going through the contents.
target: Defectus riti precationis maritimae anno praeterito in mari anomaliam effecit? Lumian non potuit quin id ita interpretaret postquam singula argumenta perlegit.

source: Studying the note in his hand, a familiar fragrance wafted to him.
target: Notam in manu tenens, odor notus ad eum pervenit.

source: After some thought, Lumian recalled the source: the Paco family’s Madame Giorgia’s perfume.
target: Post aliquod meditabundum tempus, Lumian originem recoluit: unguentum Dominae Giorgiae ex familia Paco.

source: Were they inexperienced or intentionally leaving a trace, implying the Paco family as the source of this information?
target: Num erant inexperti aut studiose vestigia reliquerent ut familia Paco tamquam fons huius notitiae designaretur?

source: Lumian mused to himself, recalling the sudden appearance of a humanoid lizard in the Paco family, the severe injuries to Rubió Paco’s mother Martha, and the peculiarities surrounding them.
target: Lumian sibi meditatus est, recolens repentinam apparationem lacertae humanoidis in familia Paco, graves laesiones matris Rubió Paco, Martha, et res insuetas circa eos.

source: Is the core issue the sea’s abnormality?
target: Num ipsa anomalia maris sit quaestio primaria?

source: Has it weakened the Paco family’s Beyonders, causing an ordinary person without sea lineage to transform into a humanoid lizard?
target: An debilitavit Beyonder familiae Paco, ita ut homo ordinarius sine stirpe marina in lacertam humanoidem verteatur?

source: Perhaps they don’t want other sea spawn to know and were lacking the strength to handle the humanoid lizard, thus seeking foreign adventurers to resolve it?
target: Forsitan nolunt alii maris progenies noscere, et vi caruerunt ad tractandum lacertam humanoidem, ideo adventatores externos quaerebant ad rem solvendam?

source: Lumian gained a new insight into the contradictions within the Paco family’s commission.
target: Lumian novam perceptionem cepit de contradictionibus in mandato familiae Paco.

source: Lato Guiaro and Juan Oro hadn’t mentioned the sea’s anomaly.
target: Lato Guiaro et Juan Oro anomaliam maris non memoraverunt.

source: They only noted the sea’s increased violence without the ritual’s appeasement, the frequent departure of Death Navigators from their territory, and the declining strength of the Children of the Sea.
target: Notaverunt tantum auctam violentiam maris absque placatione ritu, frequentem discessum Navigatorum Mortis ex regione sua, atque declinantem potentiam Puerorum Maris.

source: From their perspective, this situation seemed normal, foreseeable, and unrelated to any anomaly.
target: Ex eorum prospectu, haec res visa erat normalis, praedicabilis, nec ad quamlibet anomaliam pertinens.

source: Did the anomaly solely affect the Paco family, or did Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, and others intentionally conceal this matter?
target: Num sola familia Paco afficiebat an Juan Oro, Lato Guiaro, et alii hanc rem conscie celaverunt?

source: Are they guarding against each other?
target: An invicem se servent?

source: Lumian speculated as he watched the note consumed by crimson flames in his palm.
target: Lumian speculatus est, dum notam in palma sua, ignibus rubris devoratam, observabat.

source: He leaned toward the latter possibility.
target: Ad hanc verisimilitudinem inclinavit.

source: If the Paco family wasn’t unique, the sea’s anomaly should have widespread effects, not solely targeting them.
target: Si familia Paco unica non esset, anomalia maris effectus latius habere debebat, non solum in eos incidere.

source: This understanding shed light on Rubió Paco’s disdain when speaking of the Maidens of the Sea.
target: Hoc intellectus lumen afferebat in fastidium Rubió Paco, cum de Puellis Maris loquebatur.

source: Discovering the truth about the Maidens of the Sea and his true lineage likely filled him with self‐loathing and contempt for the entire sea prayer ritual.
target: Inventio veritatis de Puellis Maris atque de stirpe sua veritate eum verisimiliter replevit auto-odium et contemptu totius ritu precationis maritimae.

source: He’d rather forfeit his family’s inheritance than marry another Maiden of the Sea.
target: Malit hereditatem familiae suae perdere quam aliam Puellam Maris in matrimonium ducere.

source: When the sea anomaly affected the entire Paco family, these emotions reached their zenith.
target: Cum anomalia maris totam familiam Paco afficeret, hae passiones apicem attigerunt.

source: Lumian’s suspicion grew that Nolfi’s covert ally might be Rubió Paco.
target: Crescit suspicio Lumiani, ut socius occultus Nolfi esset Rubió Paco.

source: Regardless, given the Paco family’s resources and status, they could lead a comfortable life even without the sea prayer ritual.
target: Attamen, ratione opum et status familiae Paco, vitam commodam agere poterant etiam sine ritu precationis maritimae.

source: Lugano stood to the side, observing his employer as Lumian delved into deep thought after reading the note.
target: Lugano stetit ad latus, dum dominum suum observabat, atque Lumian post legendam notam in profunda cogitatione se immergebat.

source: A twinge of nervousness and fluster crossed Lugano’s demeanor.
target: Trepidatio et perturbatio in vultu Lugano apparuerunt.

source: Is something about to unfold again?
target: Num aliquid rursus evenerit?

source: Lumian glanced up at Lugano, his expression pensive.
target: Lumian ad Lugano intuens, vultu cogitativo, aspexit.

source: “Though I haven’t reached Highlander proficiency, I’ve mastered the daily words I need.
target: „Quamquam disciplinam Highlander nondum adeptus sum, verba cotidiana quae mihi opus sunt callide didici.“

source: My body language suffices for a normal life in Port Santa.
target: „Gestus meus corporis sufficit ad vitam normalem in Port Santa.“

source: Plus, the folks I’ll be dealing with know Intisian.
target: „Praeterea, homines cum quibus operabor, Intisianum sciunt.“

source: I can settle the remaining balance now and offer you a free ‘teleport’ back to Trier.”
target: „Nunc possum reliquam rationem solvere atque tibi gratuitam 'teleportationem' ad Trier offerre.”

source: Instinctively, Lugano shook his head.
target: Instinctive, Lugano caput concussit.

source: “You can’t attend to Ludwig when you’re in action. If I leave now, who’ll keep an eye on him?”
target: „Non potes Ludwigum curare cum agitur. Si nunc discedo, quis eum custodiat?“

source: It’s unclear who’s watching whom… Lumian stared at Lugano for a brief moment, sensing, for the first time, an unsettling undertone in the interpreter’s demeanor.
target: Non liquet quis quem vigilet… Lumian per brevem momentum Lugano aspexit, primum subtonum inquietum in habitu interpreti sentiens.

source: Despite prior attacks and potential risks, there was an inexplicable resistance to the suggestion of terminating the employment contract and taking his offer for a safe departure!
target: Quamquam impetus praeteriti et pericula potentialia erant, inexplicabilis tamen resistentia fuit ad suggestionem contractus operandi rescindendi et oblationem eius pro tutam discessum accipiendi!

source: It wouldn’t even cost him a verl d’or!
target: Neque quidem “verl d’or” illi pretium constare debebat!

source: Considering Lugano’s typical behavior and personality, Lumian assumed he would readily accept the remaining payment and leave Port Santa.
target: Considerato Lugano more et indole, Lumian putavit eum solutionem reliquam facile recepturum atque Port Santa discedere.

source: Reality, however, proved otherwise.
target: Attamen res reales aliter se ostenderunt.

source: Perhaps Lugano himself doesn’t understand the rationale behind his decision.
target: Forsitan ipse Lugano rationem decisionis suae non intellegit.

source: It is just an “instinctive” choice…
target: Hoc solum est electio instinctiva…

source: Lumian nodded subtly, opting not to press further on settling the final payment and terminating their employment contract.
target: Lumian subtiliter annuit, optans non pergere ad solvendum vectigal ultimum atque contractum operis terminare.

source: In Milo Village, within the Oro family’s extensively renovated ancestral house, Juan Oro lounged by the window, puffing on a hookah, his gaze fixed on the sun dipping below the horizon, casting an orange glow.
target: In vico Milo, intra domum priscam familiae Oro diligenter renovatam, Juan Oro ad fenestram recubuit, fistulam fumigans, oculos in solem labentem infra horizontem intuebatur, qui lumen aurantiacum spargebat.

source: His thoughts drifted to the impending sea prayer ritual, just over a week away.
target: Cogitationes eius ad imminens ritum precationis maritimae vagabantur, paulo plus quam septimana abesse.

source: Abruptly, he turned his head, eyeing a shadow near the door.
target: Subito, vertit caput, umbram iuxta ianuam intuebatur.

source: The darkness stirred, and a man with green eyes, sporting a golden straw hat, white shirt, and black vest, emerged—the adventurer, Louis Berry.
target: Tenebrae excitatae sunt, et vir oculis viridibus, galea aurea straminea indutus, camisia alba ac vestimento nigro perlatus, apparuit—adventor, Louis Berry.

source: “Why are you here again?” Juan Oro sighed, switching to Intisian.
target: „Cur iterum hic es?” suspiravit Juan Oro, linguam suam in Intisian convertens.

source: Lumian chuckled, dragging a chair into the sun’s waning rays.
target: Lumian risens, sellam ad radias solis minuantem traxit.

source: “I’ve got another inquiry and a heads-up about a particular operation.”
target: „Aliud quaestionem habeo atque praemonitionem de certa operatione.“

source: Juan’s eyes narrowed.
target: Oculi Juan contracti sunt.

source: “What scheme are you plotting now?”
target: „Quid nunc machinare conaris?“

source: “Tonight, I intend to infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: „Hac nocte intendo in domum Gubernatoris Maris insidiari.

source: If I go unnoticed, I’ll observe the rooms where the vigil ritual is conducted.
target: Si non animadvertar, locos ubi ritus vigiliae celebratur, observabo.

source: If discovered, I’ll make a swift exit.
target: Si detectus fuerit, celeriter exiam.

source: This fits my radical persona and purported motives, doesn’t it?
target: Hoc congruit cum persona mea radicali atque suppositis motivis, nonne?

source: It’ll deflect suspicion from our covert collaboration,” Lumian disclosed, a hint of a smile in his explanation.
target: Suspicionem a nostra collaboratione occulta avertet, inquit Lumian, paulo subridente.

source: Juan Oro harbored an unexplained sense of threat from Louis Berry, yet he found no tangible evidence.
target: Juan Oro sensum inexplicabilem minationis a Ludovico Berry ferebat, at nulla perspicua probatione invenit.

source: Despite this, Lumian’s words resonated with an unsettling logic.
target: Non obstante hoc, verba Lumiani cum logica perturbante resonabant.

source: He drew a deep drag from his hookah in silence before he spoke.
target: In silentio, fumum profundum ex fistula sua inhavit, antequam locutus est.

source: “What are you getting at?”
target: „Quid insinuis?“

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: “I’m curious to see the ring that marries the sea, its intricate engravings, and the patterns it bears.
target: „Curiosus sum videre anulum quod mare coniungit, ejus inscriptiones intricatas et formas quas gerit.

source: I know you’ve only crafted the ring mold and haven’t completed the ritual to infuse it with something special.
target: Scio te solum formam anuli confecisse nec ritum ad eum aliquid speciale infundendum perfecisse.

source: However, after serving as deputy host 11 times and assisting even more, I’m confident you’ve memorized the patterns, symbols, and structure.”
target: Attamen, postquam undecies tamquam vice hospitis munus explevisti atque etiam pluries adiuvisti, certus sum te formas, symbola, atque structuram bene meminisse.

source: Juan Oro stiffened, his tone turning icy.
target: Juan Oro riguit, et vox eius in gelu versa est.

source: “What’s your motive?”
target: „Quid est propositum tuum?“

source: The room’s afterglow, touched by the setting sun, dimmed suddenly, as if being pulled into another dimension.
target: Splendor residuus camerae, sole occidente tactus, subito obscuratus est, quasi in aliam dimensionem traheretur.

source: Unfazed, Lumian responded, “Why all the secrecy? Haven’t you heard that the ring’s design, patterns, and structure have long been exposed?”
target: Imperturbatus Lumian respondit, „Cur tanta secretio? Nonne audivisti designum, figuras atque structuram anuli diu patefactos esse?“

source: Juan Oro’s eyes narrowed. “When did this happen?”
target: Oculi Juan Oro contracti sunt. „Quando hoc evenit?“

source: Lumian arched an eyebrow.
target: Lumian supercilium elevavit.

source: “Didn’t my companion inform you of the true reason behind the sea prayer ritual failure?”
target: „Nonne socius meus te certiorem fecit de vera causa defectus ritu precationis maritimae?“

source: “He merely confirmed the fake Iru on the ship.” Juan Oro had his suspicions.
target: „Ille solum Iru fictum in navi confirmavit.” Juan Oro suspiciones habuit.

source: Lumian grinned, shaking his head.
target: Lumian subridit et caput concussit.

source: He began unraveling his deductions, starting with the custom-made fake ring in Torres and the orchestrated lamb sacrifice sent to the ship after a bribe.
target: Incepit deductiones suas explicare, incipiens a falso anulo in Torres confecto et agnello sacrificio ordinato, quod post munus in navi missum erat.

source: Juan Oro held his silence, his countenance growing darker.
target: Juan Oro silentium retinuit, et vultus eius obscuritatem adeptus est.

source: After a tense pause, he spoke in a hoarse tone, “Not many are privy to the intricacies of the Ring of the Sea Queen, and the fact that sea spawn seldom inspect the sacrificial offerings’ entrails.”
target: Post brevem moram tensam, voce rauca locutus est: „Non multi sunt qui intricata Anuli Reginae Maris cognoscant, atque quod proles maris raro viscera oblationum sacrificiorum inspiciant.”

source: Each of them, the Children of the Sea, veterans of countless core rituals, are still alive… Iru and Salah were oblivious…”
target: Omnes hi, Pueri Maris, veteres in innumerabilibus ritibus cardinalibus, adhuc vivunt… Iru et Salah inscii erant.

source: As Juan Oro’s words, spoken through gritted teeth, reached Lumian’s ears, a sudden realization dawned upon him.
target: Cum verba Juan Oro, inter dentes strictos dicta, ad aures Lumiani pervenerunt, subito revelatio illi orta est.

source: Ultraman is affiliated with the Fisheries Guild, a Child of the Sea endowed with numerous powers and a distinct status!
target: Ultraman cum Gilda Piscandi affiliatus est, Puer Maris plurimis potentiis atque dignitate singulari praeditus!

source: There’s also the possibility that he’s manipulated such an individual, establishing a clandestine “partnership.”
target: Exstat etiam possibilitas eum talem hominem manipulavisse et societatem clandestinam instituisse.

source: Without such a connection, how could April Fool’s possess precise details about the ceremonial ring’s appearance and exploit the sea prayer ritual’s “supervisory” loophole?
target: Sine tali nexu, quomodo April Fools notitias accuratas de specie anuli caerimonialis habere et hiatus “supervisorialem” ritu precationis maritimae explere posset?

source: Even though I Know Someone mentioned that Ultraman is a Sun pathway Beyonder, it doesn’t rule out his identity as a Child of the Sea.
target: Etiamsi “I Know Someone” commemoravit Ultraman esse Beyonder viae Solis, id tamen non excludit eius identitatem ut Puer Maris.

source: Transforming into a Child of the Sea first and then drinking the Sun pathway’s potion shouldn’t pose an issue.
target: Primum in Puerem Maris transformari, deinde potionem viae Solis bibere, nullum impedimentum esse debet.

source: The power of the Child of the Sea resonates with the cosmos, and the Sun and the cosmos are inherently compatible.
target: Potentia Pueris Maris cum universo resonat, et Sol cum universo intrinsece compatibilia sunt.

source: Is April Fool’s true motive for disrupting the sea prayer ritual preparations related to Ultraman or his collaborator aiming to fully control the power or the palace at the bottom of the sea?
target: Num verus motivus April Fools perturbandi praeparationes ritu precationis maritimae ad Ultraman aut eius collaboratorem refertur, qui intendunt potentiam vel palatium in fundo maris omnino regere?

source: Lumian’s thoughts gradually clarified.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani paulatim clarificatae sunt.

source: He looked at Juan Oro with a relaxed smile and remarked, “If there wasn’t a mole, how could the sea prayer ritual be disrupted so easily?”
target: Ad Juan Oro, subrisu relaxedo, aspexit et dixit: „Si non fuisset talpa, quomodo ritu precationis maritimae tam facile pertuberaretur?“

source: Juan Oro had harbored similar suspicions for the past year; Lumian’s words were irrefutable.
target: Juan Oro suspiciones similes per annum fovit; verba Lumiani indubitable erant.

source: After some contemplation with an unpleasant expression, Juan Oro composed himself and stated, “I have to uncover the traitor before the official sea sacrifice…”
target: Post aliquod spatium cogitationis, vultu incommodus, Juan Oro se composuit et dixit: „Proditorem detegere debeo ante sacrum maris officiale…“

source: At this point, Juan Oro turned his gaze to Lumian.
target: Hoc tempore, Juan Oro oculos suos in Lumian vertit.

source: “I might need your cooperation on something when the time comes.”
target: „Fortasse, cum tempus advenerit, cooperationem tuam mihi opus erit.“

source: “Oh, you’re fishing too?” Lumian replied with a smile, “No problem.”
target: „O, et tu piscas quoque?” subridens respondit Lumian, „Nullum problema!”

source: Juan Oro set down his hookah and left his seat.
target: Juan Oro fistulam suam deposuit et sedem reliquit.

source: He walked to the desk, retrieved a pen and paper, and began sketching.
target: Ad mensam ambulavit, calamus et charta cepit, et delineare coepit.

source: Nearly ten minutes later, the old man staggered to Lumian and handed him the paper.
target: Fere decem minuta post, senex titubans ad Lumian accessit et chartam ei tradidit.

source: Lumian glanced at it and recognized six designs—representing the front, left, right, back, front, and inner parts of the Ring of the Sea Queen.
target: Lumian illud aspexit et sex designationes agnovit—repraesentantes partes: anterior, sinistra, dextra, posterior, iterum anterior, et internam Anuli Reginae Maris.

source: Each design featured intricate and mystifying symbols and patterns.
target: Unumquodque consilium insignia intricata et figurae arcanae exhibebat.

source: “It’s actually useless for you to obtain it. It won’t have any effect,” Juan Oro said in a low, raspy voice.
target: „Revera tibi inutilis est id obtinere. Nullum effectum habebit,” inquit Juan Oro voce humili et rauca.

source: The corresponding sea spawn have to use their special abilities to inscribe them on the ring and corrode them for six hours to please the sea and gain her recognition.
target: Proles maris idoneae facultates suas speciales uti debent ut ea in anulo inscribant atque sex horas corrodant, ad mare placandum et eius agnitionem consequendam.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “I have no intention of replicating one.”
target: Lumian annuit et respondit, „Non intendo alterum replicare.“

source: He was obtaining it solely to send to Madam Magician for interpretation.
target: Illud obtinebat solum ut Dominae Magicae ad interpretationem tradendum.

source: He then asked, “Is this the ring-making segment of the vigil ritual? Is there no other step?”
target: Tum interrogavit, „Estne haec pars creationis anuli in ritu vigiliae? Num nullus alius gradus adest?“

source: “There’s another step. An assistant host will take the ring to the basement and place it in front of the patterns and symbols representing our ancestors for an hour. This is a show of respect to our ancestors, like greeting the elders before a wedding,” Juan Oro explained briefly.
target: „Alius gradus est. Hospes adiutor annulum in subsolum ducit et eum coram figuris atque symbolis, qui maiores nostros repraesentant, per unam horam imponet. Hoc est ostentatio reverentiae erga maiores nostros, sicut salutatio senioribus ante nuptias,” breviter explicavit Juan Oro.

source: After a moment of contemplation, Lumian responded, “Can you also draw the patterns and symbols representing your ancestors?”
target: Post aliquod spatium cogitationis, Lumian respondit, „Potesne etiam delineare figuras et symbola repraesentantia maiores tuos?“

source: Juan Oro returned to the desk.
target: Juan Oro ad mensam rediit.

source: This time, he completed it in just two minutes.
target: Hoc tempore, id intra tantum duas minutas confecit.

source: Lumian took it and noticed scattered lines and arcs.
target: Lumian illud accepit et lineas atque arcus dispersos animadvertit.

source: Many details were missing from the middle, making it impossible to discern its original appearance.
target: Multa ex mediis partibus defuerunt, ita ut eius aspectus originalis discerneri non posset.

source: “Seeing it in person might allow you to make connections easier.” Juan Oro sighed again.
target: „Videns id in persona, coniunctiones facilius efficere poteris,” iterum suspiravit Juan Oro.

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “Then I’ll infiltrate the Governor of the Sea’s residence tonight.”
target: „Tum hanc nocte in domum Gubernatoris Maris insidiari intendo,” inquit Lumian.

source: Juan Oro tersely acknowledged his words.
target: Juan Oro verba eius breviter confirmavit.

source: “Be careful of the sea spawn there. They have their own specialties. They might not be very strong, but they can counter certain abilities of yours.”
target: „Cave proles maris ibi. Unam aliquamque specialitatem habent. Forsitan non sint valde fortes, sed certas tuas virtutes oppugnare possunt.”

source: Late at night, under the crimson moonlight, Lumian appeared near the cathedral-like building.
target: Nocte sero, sub lumine rubro lunae, Lumian prope aedificium quasi cathedralicium apparuit.
